prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
The evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to noise-corrected results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Selection Carousel Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen into a full grid showcase with high-res pet character cards and key personality tags. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 64.8% and long decision times (89s median, 1017s mean).)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Activity Checklist: Add an animated progress checklist and system status indicators to the waiting screen while pet generation completes. (why: The waiting step takes 201s median / 2336s mean, causing high abandonments and support tickets asking if the pet will appear.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Onboarding Screen: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen explaining key desktop controls (drag, right-click, hide to tray, talk) right after the home intro. (why: Multiple support emails complain about not knowing how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move sign-in to take place after pet selection/creation so users experience pet adoption before creating their account. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users before they even choose a pet. Moving sign-in builds emotional investment first.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Path Selection View: Rebuild the path selection screen into a split side-by-side view clearly contrasting standard pets with custom photo generation. (why: Path choice shows a massive mean time of 514s, indicating confusion or friction in deciding which route to take.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Display explicit visual hints on the upload screen recommending clear front-facing lighting for pet photo generation. (why: Support tickets highlight that custom pet creation fails or results look wrong (3 emails).)
6: [finish, redesign] Interactive Pet Welcome Stage Redesign: Redesign home_intro into an interactive stage showcase where users immediately test pet actions with live feedback. (why: The final step drops conversion to 64.8%, leaving overall onboarding conversion at just 19.0%.)
7: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Warning Hint: Add persistent login context notes helping returning users select the right auth provider to prevent account resets. (why: 8 support emails (the top support issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
8: [home, notification] Background Desktop Ready Notification: Enable system desktop notifications while waiting so users can minimize the window safely during generation. (why: Waiting step takes 201s median / 2336s mean; letting users minimize reduces perceived wait time and app abandonments.)
